title: Dread Warren round 2: creatures in every pose, new spider caves
desc: J rated v2.0106 (cave scenes and arena DROP; spiders, Matron, Lights out IMPROVE), then: "creatures and new cave try, i want to see them in various positions to display as much as possible in these models, remove the columns from the big caves, try to make the burrows and terrain more complex and maybe spider favored". Every spider in three builds and five poses (walking, wall, drop thread, rearing, dead); the Matron in three abdomens and four poses; three Lights out moments; three new caves with no columns. All turn. Ceiling walking still on hold.

takes.name: Broodlings: plate
takes.facts: 0.5x; Plate: a black core under separate yellow hard-light scale bands with dark gaps, small glowing joints; every pose turns: walking (feet lifting in turn), clinging to a wall, dropped on its thread, rearing to strike, dead on its back

takes.name: Broodlings: shard
takes.facts: 0.5x; Shard: faceted see-through fear glass round a dark core, shard spines on the back, spiked knees; like glass newborns; every pose turns: walking (feet lifting in turn), clinging to a wall, dropped on its thread, rearing to strike, dead on its back

takes.name: Broodlings: bristle
takes.facts: 0.5x; Bristle: a dark furred body bristling with yellow spines, banded legs, a glowing eye mark on the abdomen; every pose turns: walking (feet lifting in turn), clinging to a wall, dropped on its thread, rearing to strike, dead on its back

takes.name: Dread Phantom: shell
takes.facts: Shell: a hollow see-through spider of light, sharper eyes, static clinging close; every pose turns: walking (feet lifting in turn), clinging to a wall, dropped on its thread, rearing to strike, dead on its back

takes.name: Dread Phantom: wire
takes.facts: Wire: only its edges, drawn in glowing lines, like a construct outline; every pose turns: walking (feet lifting in turn), clinging to a wall, dropped on its thread, rearing to strike, dead on its back

takes.name: Dread Phantom: split
takes.facts: Split: the head solid, the abdomen coming apart into a cloud of yellow static (mid-blink); every pose turns: walking (feet lifting in turn), clinging to a wall, dropped on its thread, rearing to strike, dead on its back

takes.name: The Matron: lantern cage
takes.facts: Lantern cage: fear glass inside a standing gold cage of thick bars and collars, the flaring core and broodlings inside; four poses turning: scythes folded like a mantis, striking, rearing to scream, dropping on her thread with scythes reaching down
takes.cam3p: Cam W3a1 The Matron: lantern cage

takes.name: The Matron: cracked chitin
takes.facts: Cracked chitin: an opaque black-and-yellow plated shell split by deep glowing cracks, the core showing through little glass windows; four poses turning: scythes folded like a mantis, striking, rearing to scream, dropping on her thread with scythes reaching down
takes.cam3p: Cam W3a2 The Matron: cracked chitin

takes.name: The Matron: hourglass
takes.facts: Hourglass: two glass bulbs joined at a gold waist, broodlings in both, a stream of light falling between them; four poses turning: scythes folded like a mantis, striking, rearing to scream, dropping on her thread with scythes reaching down

takes.name: Lights out: the scream
takes.facts: phase 3 begins: her scream puts every light out; your ring gutters to a spark, and all you see are her eyes, her lantern abdomen and the eyes waiting in eight burrow mouths
takes.cam3p: Cam W3c1 Lights out: the scream

takes.name: Lights out: the reignite
takes.facts: you hold use for 3 s and the ring reignites by force: a green burst ring sweeps the floor, green dissolve rises, the spiders round you are flipped onto their backs and she rears away
takes.cam3p: Cam W3c2 Lights out: the reignite

takes.name: Lights out: the shell opens
takes.facts: the 10 s overcharge: your will beam lands and green light floods into her cracks, her shell opening where the gold lightning was
takes.cam3p: Cam W3c3 Lights out: the shell opens

takes.name: Burrow warren
takes.facts: a bowl-shaped chamber with no columns, its walls riddled with 16 round spider burrows at every height (silk collars, trip lines fanning across the floor from the mouths, egg nests in side pockets lit from inside); Hunters wait in the mouths and on the walls; the whole lump of ground turns

takes.name: Funnel hollow
takes.facts: four terraces stepping down with undercut, overhanging lips (spiders hang under them) into a great funnel web that drains into the glowing nest hole; burrows in every terrace wall; a Hunter climbs out of the hole, a Weaver drops on its thread, broodlings cross the terraces; no columns

takes.name: Crevice
takes.facts: a deep winding crack, wider at the top, its walls honeycombed with 34 burrow holes at every height, short ledges, silk ladders zig-zagging wall to wall, two sheet webs across, prey cocoons hanging on threads, eggs glowing in holes; Hunters cling at the burrow mouths; you stand on the floor with the ring; no columns
